description: This file contains implementation of conversion, input, and output routines for rational numbers and 32-bit integers, including functions for string parsing, number formatting, rational arithmetic, and base conversions within a numerical computation library.

classes.name: PNUMBER
classes.description: Pointer to a number structure representing arbitrary precision numbers.

classes.name: PRAT
classes.description: Pointer to a rational number structure representing a fraction of two numbers.

methods.name: stripzeroesnum
methods.description: Removes trailing zeros from a number's mantissa and adjusts exponent accordingly.

methods.name: NumberToString
methods.description: Converts a number to its string representation in various formats and bases.

methods.name: RatToString
methods.description: Converts a rational number to its string representation with specified formatting.

methods.name: RatToNumber
methods.description: Converts a rational number to a decimal number scaled to a requested base and precision.

methods.name: flatrat
methods.description: Simplifies a rational number by converting it to a numerator/denominator form.

methods.name: gcd
methods.description: Calculates the greatest common divisor of two integer numbers represented as PNUMBER.

methods.name: i32factnum
methods.description: Computes the factorial of an integer in a specified radix, returning a number.

methods.name: i32prodnum
methods.description: Computes the product of a range of integers in a specified radix.

methods.name: numpowi32
methods.description: Raises a number to an integer power within a specified radix.

methods.name: ratpowi32
methods.description: Raises a rational number to an integer power.
